name: E-6B Mercury
summary: Four-engine airborne command post and strategic communications relay (TACAMO) based on the Boeing 707-320, linking national command to ballistic-missile submarines and bombers.

wings: Elongated pods at the wingtips (electronic and antenna pods)
engines: Four high-bypass turbofans in fat nacelles on pylons
fuselage: Long narrowbody airliner fuselage with few windows
Usually white upper fuselage over grey
Fairings under the belly for trailing-wire antennas; no refueling boom

tellTales: Four-engine narrowbody with pods on the wingtips
White-topped Navy jet with no refueling boom and no radar disc
Small fairings under the belly for trailing antennas

confusedWith.howToTell: The E-6 has wingtip pods, no boom and a longer fuselage; the KC-135 has plain wingtips and a refueling boom.
The E-6 has wingtip pods and no radar disc; the E-3 carries a large disc on struts above the rear fuselage.
The E-6 has wingtip pods and a plain nose; the RC-135 has a thimble nose and cheek fairings.
